newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - River Forest, Ill..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - River Forest, Ill..

text.p: Separate sealed bids for the bonds will be received until 12:00 Noon C.D.T.,

at the office of Kane, McKenna Capital, Inc., 150 North Wacker Drive, Suite 1600, Chicago, Illinois, for the above bonds dated October 15, 1996 and maturing December 1, 1997- 2013, inclusive. The Bonds are callable on December 1, 2006 and thereafter in the manner provided in the Official Notice of Sale. The
City will designate the Bonds as
obligations'' pursuant to the small issuer exemption

provided by Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986. The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The City will furnish the bonds with CUSIP numbers printed thereon and the approving legal opinion of Chapman and Cutler, Chicago, Illinois. All bids must be for all bonds at a price of not less than 99% plus accrued interest. Bid forms, together with the Official Statement and Official Notice of Sale, may be obtained from:
